warnings.title: W2-STILL-PRESENT: the pool-cap margin clamp excludes cap 1 — a legal pool_max_packets=1 catalog still fires a Pool_Exhaustion crisis that can NEVER resolve (and caps 2-4's clamped resolve band is unreachable under the game's continuous baseline demand)
warnings.evidence: resolve: 'pool_margin := CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN' / 'if cat.balance.pool_max_packets > 1 && u32(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) <= pool_margin { pool_margin = u32(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) - 1 }' / 'cleared = len(state.flow.packets) + int(pool_margin) < int(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) && !drop_of_reason_this_tick(state, .Pool_Exhaustion)'. Catalog validation: only 'pool_max_packets must be > 0' — caps 1-2 legal. Probe: cap 1 trigger@1200, zero resolves through tick 4300 (active=1); caps 2/3/4 zero resolves through 3600.
warnings.detail: r3 W-2's fix claims caps 1-2 now resolve. cap 1: the `> 1` guard leaves margin=2, so len+2<1 never holds — permanent by arithmetic. caps 2-4: the len<cap-margin band needs a drop-free near-empty eval; under the era-3 baseline (6 spawns/tick) that state never occurs (probe-verified). No test pins the clamp.
warnings.recommended_fix: Clamp with max(1,cap)-1 for cap 1 (margin 0), and validate pool_max_packets >= a sane floor (probes show 4 is still permanent — consider keying the small-cap resolve on drop-absence instead of depth), plus a pin.
